the Val/Val homozygous genotype of the SOD2 polymorphism may be a genetic risk factor for the development of lung cancer in a population from Turkey.
the Ala16Val polymorphism of the MnSod gene is a risk factor for lung cancer in the Turkish population.
Ala16Val polymorphism of the MnSODE gene was associated with lung cancer susceptibility in a Turkish population.

the association of MnSOD polymorphism with lung cancer in the Turkish population.
the role of the SOD2 polymorphism in lung cancer susceptibility and the combined effect of the Val/Val genotypes and smoking.
the role of oxidative stress in the development and/or progression of lung cancer.

the Ala16Val polymorphism in the SOD2 gene is a risk factor for lung cancer in a population of Turkish patients, and that smoking is an important environmental risk factor for lung carcinogenesis.

the Val allele and Val/Val genotype may be a risk factor for lung cancer, especially when associated with smoking, in a Turkish population.
the Val16 allele and Val/Val homozygosity are significantly associated with an increased risk of lung cancer, and this effect is stronger in individuals who are also smokers.

the Ala16Val polymorphism in MnSOD is associated with lung cancer risk.
